$comment: Digital versions of the paper journal's clues, for home mode. Hand-curated; audited Oct 2026 (docs/recap.md).
clues: keyed '<scene>#<beat>' = the beat that carries the real-world instruction (or a puzzle/timer beat).
items[]: images shown in the clue. file = web copy in web/assets/journal/, built from src (+ crop/rotate/grid) by tools/build-journal-assets.py.

items[].sheet: the item is a transparent sheet/piece the player drags over the item before it. true = same size as the base, snaps at (0,0); or { w: width as a fraction of the base, at: [x, y] top-left target as fractions }.
items[].turn: the item must be rotated until it lines up (starts at `angle` degrees, aligned at 0).
reveal: { label, text, items } shown after the player presses `label` (e.g. searching the spot on a map).
answers: accepted answers, compared exactly after removing case, spaces and punctuation (list every accepted variant). No answers = look-and-continue.
hints: revealed one at a time; after the last one the solution is shown. Puzzles that decide the ending (24, 37) have no hints on purpose.
note: added to the notebook when solved. image + hotspots (timer beats): tap areas [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the image.
Unknown originals recreated for the revival: the numbers on Gabriele's coaster (tools/assets-src/coaster-ribalta.svg).

14#11.title: The fountain poem
14#11.text: Sirio's code from 'that famous evening': eight strips of the poem carved around the fountain in Piazza Bausan, one per side (page 15). On each strip a bar is a letter, a gap is a space; the orange bar is the letter to keep. Walk round the fountain anticlockwise from #1.

items.alt: Journal page 15: strips #1 to #8 and Sirio's sketch
The fountain in Piazza Bausan

reveal.label: Read the inscription
reveal.text: Around the fountain: #1 STORIE DEL PIAVE · #2 STORIE DELL'ISONZO · #3 ESSA È LA VOCE DEI NOSTRI MORTI · #4 CHE GIAMMAI S'ESTINGUE · #6 FONTANA PIA LA TUA VOCE · #7 QUIETA IN MURMURE · #8 PERENNE CI RACCONTA. Side #5 is worn away: its orange letter is V.

14#11.question: Which place does the code name?
hints: #1 is STORIE DEL PIAVE read right to left: its orange letter is P.
P-Z-A is short for 'piazza'.
